items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ‘Cause you said Ernie, so that threw me, I was thinking Ernie Wilkins, I know it’s not Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: There it is, that’s the guy.
